blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Today we learn the days of the week in English. At Czarnikow we use them every day — in meetings, emails and schedules.

The week starts on Monday and ends on Sunday. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. Today you learn five important words. We go step by step.

English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: When does the week start?
items.why: "The week starts on Monday and ends on Sunday."

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.why: "Saturday and Sunday are the weekend."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five important words."

items.q: "We go step by step" suggests that the lesson is…
items.why: Inferência: "step by step" mostra que a lição é calma e simples, feita para iniciantes.

items.q: The message "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" is there to…
items.why: Inferência: é uma frase de motivação — quer dizer "você é capaz".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie mostrar a agenda da semana para o novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Let me show you our weekly schedule.

The team is in the office from Monday to Thursday. We start at nine in the morning. On Monday we have our big meeting. It is important, so please come on time.

On Tuesday and Wednesday we work on emails and reports. On Thursday we have training. It is fun and easy, don't worry.

On Friday I work from home. Many people take Friday to work from home too. The office is quiet on Friday.

Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. We do not work. The office closes at six in the evening every day.

Your schedule is on the wall and in your email. Any questions? Have a nice week!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What day does the team have the big meeting?
items.why: "On Monday we have our big meeting."

items.q: What time does the team start in the morning?
items.why: "We start at nine in the morning."

items.q: Where does Sophie work on Friday?
items.why: "On Friday I work from home."

items.q: Sophie says "please come on time" for the Monday meeting. This suggests that the meeting is…
options: important, so being late is a problem
items.why: Inferência: ela pede pontualidade porque a reunião é importante.

items.q: Why is the office probably quiet on Friday?
options: Because many people work from home
Because the team is on training
items.why: Inferência: muitos trabalham de casa na sexta, então há menos gente no escritório.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The team meeting is on Monday." Monday is…
items.why: Monday = segunda-feira, o primeiro dia da semana de trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I am in the office on ___, the second day of the week."
items.why: Tuesday = terça-feira, o segundo dia da semana.

items.q: "This week is very busy." Week means…
items.why: Week = semana (de segunda a domingo).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We do not work on Saturday and Sunday. Have a nice ___!"
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).

items.q: "My schedule is full this week." Schedule means…
items.why: Schedule = agenda / horário: os dias e horas do seu trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no trabalho para falar da agenda. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I have a day off on Friday." A day off is…
options: a free day, with no work
items.why: Day off = dia de folga, um dia sem trabalho.

items.q: "On Monday I work from home." This means I…
items.why: Work from home = trabalhar de casa, sem ir ao escritório.

items.q: "Let's catch up on Tuesday." To catch up means to…
options: meet and talk to share news
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo/assunto em dia, conversar rapidamente.

items.q: "We wrap up the meeting at five." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = terminar, encerrar (uma reunião ou tarefa).

items.q: "Please check in with me on Wednesday." To check in means to…
options: give a quick update to someone
items.why: Check in (with someone) = dar um retorno rápido, falar para atualizar.
